title: 第015章 光环 原暗永恒第016章 堕天原暗伊斯塔
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 为什么奇珍级别的宝物会这么便宜呢？
当然是因为现在是新手期，要明白一个道理，新手期的宝物不算宝物，转化成自身的实力才是真的。
要是自己的领地都守不住，那就不要说什么宝物了，别人也不是傻子，这种等级的东西拿出来贱卖只有两个可能。
一个那就是领地出现了问题，更准确的说虚空试炼的时候选择的难度高了一点，想要拼一拼，结果就是兵种拼没了，招募兵种的资源也不够了，才会选择贱卖。
这样的情况在新手期是十分常见的，高估了自己兵种的实力，也低估了虚空试炼的难度，所以也就导致了宝物贱卖的情况时有发生。
没办法，不贱卖他们就没办法发展，没办法发展就守不住自己的领地，这属于为自己的行为买单。
另外一个领主贱卖宝物的根本原因则是为了更好的发展，一个用不上的宝物，去贩卖来自己能用的资源。
更好的发展自己领地，这类领主往往懂的取舍，有着更加长远的规划和发展。
苏业思虑了片刻之后回了消息。
【异界旅人：好，不过我只有金币，没有本源结晶，用金币交易吧。】
林小小这边看着苏业发来的消息，眼中带着一丝狡黠：“两万金币，这才第二天不是一个小数目啊，要么是初始领地有金矿，要么就是兵种足够强力，没有本源结晶？不见得吧，不过这也算一个潜力股，只是不确定是那种。”
【小小商人：好的大佬，私聊交易申请了，你确定一下。】
苏业这边看着弹出来的私聊交易申请。
【叮：小小商人向你发起了私聊交易，是否确定？】
苏业选择了确定。
一个湛蓝色的聊天框出现在苏业和林小小的面前。
苏业和林小小同时上传了自己交易的东西。
交易完成，苏业获得了黑暗之种，林小小获得了两万金币。
【小小商人：大佬合作愉快，有什么需要都可以找小小哦。】
苏业看着小小商人发来的消息。
【异界旅人：还真有，科技之种，如果有的话可以帮我留意一下。】
很快林小小就回复了消息。
【小小商人：ok，收到大佬。】
苏业看了看信息随后关掉了聊天面板，两万金币，林小小能赚多少那是她的本事，没她苏业也不会这么快就找到黑暗之种。
“看样子，新手领主之中的猛人还是有的啊。”苏业看着黑暗之种想到。
林小小这边，看着交易过来的金币，眼睛都完成了月牙：“科技之种？先是黑暗之种，然后是科技之种，他要这些东西做什么？囤货还是？管他呢，客人就是上帝，金币资源更是上帝中的上帝，商人准则，不问缘由，完成交易即可，知道的太多不是什么好事情。”
林小小开始联系自己麾下的商人，苏业是不是大佬她不清楚，但是目前为止苏业是她最大的客户没有之一。
过了新手期之后是一飞冲天，还是泯然众人那是后面的事情了，现在是她最大的客户就足够了。
“计划赶不上变化，先升级堕天圣堂，不然今天的招募名额就浪费了。”苏业直接向着堕天圣堂走了过去。
看着黑色的教堂。
【叮：是否消耗本源结晶x1000，黑暗之种x1，金币x1w升级堕天圣堂？】
content_en:
Why are rare-level treasures so cheap?
Of course, it's because it's the novice stage now. One thing to understand is that the treasures in the novice stage are not considered treasures, only when they are transformed into one's own strength.
If you can't defend your own territory, then don't talk about treasures. Others are not fools. There are only two possibilities for selling things of this level at low prices.
One is that there is a problem with the territory. To be more precise, the selection difficulty during the Void Trial is a little higher. If you want to fight for it, the result is that the troops are gone and the resources to recruit the troops are not enough, so they choose to sell it at a low price.
This situation is very common in the novice stage. They overestimate the strength of their own units and underestimate the difficulty of the Void Trial, which often leads to treasures being sold at low prices.
There is no other way. If you don't sell them at a low price, they won't be able to develop. If you can't develop, you won't be able to defend your territory. This is paying for your own behavior.
Another lord's fundamental reason for selling treasures at a low price is for better development. He sells an unused treasure for resources that he can use.
To better develop their own territory, such lords often know the trade-offs and have more long-term planning and development.
Su ye thought for a moment and then replied the message.
[Traveler from another world: Okay, but I only have gold coins and no source crystals. Let’s trade them with gold coins. 】
Lin Xiaoxiao looked at the message from Su Ye with a hint of cunning in his eyes: "Twenty thousand gold coins, it's not a small amount just the next day. Either there are gold mines in the initial territory, or the troops are strong enough and there are no source crystals? Not necessarily, but this can be considered a potential stock, but I'm not sure what kind it is."
[Small businessman: Okay, big boss, I have applied for a private chat transaction, please make sure. 】
Su ye looked at the private chat transaction application that popped up.
[Ding: A small businessman has initiated a private chat transaction with you, are you sure? 】
Su ye chose OK.
A blue chat box appeared in front of Su ye and Lin Xiaoxiao.
Su Ye and Lin Xiaoxiao uploaded their transactions at the same time.
After the transaction was completed, Su Ye obtained the Seed of Darkness and Lin Xiaoxiao received 20,000 gold coins.
[Little businessman: It’s a pleasure to cooperate with you. If you need anything, you can contact Xiaoxiao. 】
Su ye looked at the message from the small businessman.
[Traveler from another world: There really is, a seed of technology. If there is one, you can help me keep an eye on it. 】
Lin Xiaoxiao quickly replied to the message.
[Little businessman: ok, I got it from the boss. 】
Su ye looked at the message and then closed the chat panel. Twenty thousand gold coins, how much Lin Xiaoxiao could earn was up to her. Without her, Su ye would not have found the seed of darkness so quickly.
"It seems that there are still some fierce ones among the novice lords." Su Ye thought as he looked at the seeds of darkness.
On Lin Xiaoxiao's side, looking at the gold coins that were traded, his eyes were filled with crescent moons: "Seeds of technology? Seeds of darkness first, and then seeds of technology. What does he want these things for? Hoarding or what? Who cares, the customer is God, and gold coin resources are the God of Gods. Business rules, just complete the transaction regardless of the reason. Knowing too much is not a good thing."
Lin Xiaoxiao began to contact her businessmen. She didn't know whether Su ye was a big boss, but so far Su ye was one of her biggest customers.
After passing the novice stage, whether she soars into the sky or disappears into obscurity is something that will happen later. Now it is enough that she is her biggest customer.
"The plan can't keep up with the changes. Upgrade the Fallen Heaven Temple first, otherwise today's recruitment quota will be wasted." Su Ye walked directly towards the Fallen Heaven Temple.
Looking at the black church.
[Ding: Do you want to consume x1000 source crystal, x1 seed of darkness, and x1w gold coins to upgrade the Fallen Temple? 】
